overlay.basis: Read by a person from aagento-bridge highway-arch-bridge-rule-engine.ts: a highway RCC box with an arch-shaped masonry fill above it. Unlike the railway arch/slab engine it has no spanLen output or return-wall option, formation level defaults straight to the box top level, and the arch height-above-masonry clears at least 7.5 m or 0.8 m over the arch top. Every geometry value is added to levels in metres, so parameters and outputs are metres unless noted.
